contexts.text: So many heresies exist in the world, because the leaders and chiefs have looked to themselves, and have had their own glory as the end; and those things which are of the Lord and Heaven as means to the end.
From these leaders and chiefs falsity of thought concerning the Angels has been derived to others...
It was necessary that the Lord should be preached from the Word, and that thereby the Christian Church should be instaurated; but this could only be done through leaders who would do it from zeal...
When, in the Church, (evil) has invaded the overseers, governors, and leaders, religion becomes perverted...
That this doctrine has been confirmed so ingeniously... by the leaders, and by those who teach after them, that it cannot be assailed. Signified.
That all who are interiorly evil, who have professed faith alone, with, the leaders and their adherents, will assault the Divine truths of the Lord...
The leaders of the Reformers, Luther, etc. BE 22. BE 23:2. BE 24. BE 25. SciaDoc 3.
Such is every Church which is in falsities, when it has once been founded by leaders who seem to themselves like lynxes...
I have often spoken with these three leaders, (Luther, Melancthon, and Calvin).
An interior magician... to whom they adhered as their leader.
They (merely) think that the leaders are to be believed...
They had been solely in the natural affection of knowing what the leaders said...
